summary: ICL Group Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 17, 2026. Shareholders re-elected nine directors, including Yoav Doppelt and Aviad Kaufman, each with roughly 99% support, and reappointed Somekh Chaikin (KPMG) as independent auditor through the next annual meeting. No special-situation event, transaction, or strategic action is disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting-results notice equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 5.07 submission, with no terms, advisors, or deal mechanics to evaluate.
